tx_ar_hint.name: Area hint
tx_ar_hint.content: Same as line, with filled volume emphasis.

tx_bar_hint.name: Bar hint
tx_bar_hint.content: minimal chrome · rounded · goal line · highlight Sat · last value label

tx_ch_hint.name: Chrome hint
tx_ch_hint.content: Operate → minimal · Persuade / embedded cards → none · Classic reports → full

tx_cover_sub.name: Cover subtitle
tx_cover_sub.content: Native charts, progress, and composed patterns — every variation the canvas supports.

tx_dn_hint.name: Donut hint
tx_dn_hint.content: Part-of-whole with ≤5 slices. Never use for time series.

tx_ht_hint.name: Heat hint
tx_ht_hint.content: No chart kind — compose a frame grid with stepped token fills.

tx_kpi_hint.name: KPI hint
tx_kpi_hint.content: Big number + sparkline (no axes). Best for a single KPI with trend.

tx_ln_hint.name: Line hint
tx_ln_hint.content: Multi-series time trend with scale. Dots + last labels.

tx_pr_hint.name: Progress hint
tx_pr_hint.content: Use for 0–100% completion or score — not a donut of fake categories.

tx_rk_hint.name: Rank hint
tx_rk_hint.content: Label + linear progress. Prefer over categorical bars when labels matter.

tx_sg_hint.name: Segment hint
tx_sg_hint.content: Labeled horizontal stack — donut alternative when you want inline labels.

tx_sk_hint.name: Skeleton hint
tx_sk_hint.content: circle · text · rect — use while loading, never a fake chart.

tx_sm_hint.name: Multiples hint
tx_sm_hint.content: Prefer several sparklines over one crowded multi-series line when comparing entities.

tx_st_hint.name: Stacked hint
tx_st_hint.content: options.stacked: true on bar or area for composition over time.
